senses.gloss: इव ind. 1. Like, in the same manner as, वागर्थाविव संपृक्तौ R.i.1 (in this sense it indicates an उपमा); 2. as it were, as if, गुणागुणानुबन्धित्वात्तस्य सप्रसवा इव R.i.22 (in this sense it indicates an उत्प्रेक्ष); 3. in some measure, a little, e.g. कडार इवायम्; 4. nearly, almost, e.g. मुहूर्तमिव स्थित्वा.It is used with interrogative pronouns almost without any meaning, but with more elegance and force, किमिव हि मधुराणां मण्डनं नाकृतीनाम् Sak.i.
